alt.en: A large closed indigo padlock stands at the center of a gray floor. To its left lies a closed blue book with a small lock emblem on its cover, joined to the padlock by a dotted gray line. To its right, an open laptop showing lines of code sends a dashed orange line with one packet to the padlock.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一把闭合的靛蓝色大挂锁。左侧平放一本封面带小锁标记的蓝色书，以灰色点线连到挂锁；右侧一台显示代码的笔记本电脑，以带一个数据包的橙色虚线连到挂锁。

caption.en: Illustration: a laptop sends encrypted input to a computation that stays locked, drawn as a padlock, while a book stands for the specification that defines the encryption, as the Perseus authors describe homomorphic inference. It does not depict a tested deployment, the Perseus library or any measured result.
caption.zh: 示意图：笔记本电脑把加密输入送往一项始终上锁的计算（以挂锁表示），一本书代表定义加密方式的规范，对应 Perseus 作者描述的同态推理。本图不代表经过测试的部署，也不呈现 Perseus 库或任何实测结果。
